name: traces.runs
description: List run-level observability summaries from warehouse views for a project (parity with POST /api/v1/observability/traces/runs). Requires VIEW_RUNS on project_id when permission service is configured.

project_id.description: Project scope for observability rows (optional, uses session project_id)

since.description: ISO timestamp or relative window (e.g. 7d) — lower bound

until.description: ISO timestamp or relative window — upper bound
